address: 230/28 Asavamit Road, Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani, Udon Thani, 41000, Thailand
bio: This family-operated lunch spot has been a popular haunt for half a century. The dishes get their distinctive flavour from their home-made fermented fish sauce. This tasty addition elevates favourites such as mixed som tum with pork crackling and fermented sausage....
